en.heading: About the studio
paragraphs: The Makers Clay is a small pottery studio in Malaysia. Everything here is made by hand — thrown on the wheel or built by hand, then painted, glazed and fired in small batches.

I make tableware for actual use rather than for a shelf. Mugs that fit the hand properly, plates that take a knife, little dishes for the things that end up on the counter anyway. Some pieces get a face, a cat, or a small scene painted on them, because it makes people smile when they open the cupboard.

Because batches are small, some pieces are one-of-a-kind and will not come back. Others are ones I make again and again, though never quite identically — glaze moves, the kiln has its own opinion, and each firing turns out a little different.
If something here looks like it belongs in your kitchen, or you have an idea for a piece of your own, send a message. I would like to hear about it.

zh.heading: 关于工作室
paragraphs: 手作陶 The Makers Clay 是一间位于马来西亚的小陶艺工作室。这里的每一件都是手工完成的 —— 拉坯或手捏成形,然后手绘、上釉,小批量烧制。
我做的是拿来用的器皿,不是摆在架子上看的。握起来刚刚好的杯子、可以用刀叉的碟子、装那些反正会放在台面上的小东西的小碟。有些作品上会画上一张脸、一只猫,或是一个小场景,因为打开橱柜看到的时候会让人笑一下。
因为每批数量都很少,有些作品是独一无二的,售出之后就不会再有。有些则是我会反覆做的款式,但也从来不会完全一样 —— 釉会流动,窑有自己的脾气,每一次烧出来都有一点不同。
如果这里有什么看起来适合你的厨房,或者你心里有一个想做的东西,跟我说一声。我很想听听看。
